Major, fixable: the G-LIT acceptance tests are not evaluable against the frozen artifacts they gate. The criteria require a per-citation resolution_status (evaluation_rubric.yaml:138) and quantity_check (evaluation_rubric.yaml:142); grep counts are 0 for resolution_status and 0 for quantity_check in ledger/theorems.jsonl, and the frozen source registry has no resolution_status key either (artifacts/literature/registry.jsonl:1 uses status: verified-primary plus a nested verification object with evidence/evidence_type/evidence_url/http_status). The per-source matter/Lambda/dimension/symmetry metadata required at evaluation_rubric.yaml:140-141 is likewise not a structured registry field (those tokens occur only inside free text).

Major, fixable: metrics.citation_support (evaluation_rubric.yaml:260-263) weights {verified_primary, verified_secondary, partial, unresolved, contradicted} while the frozen registry's status vocabulary is {verified-api (78), verified-primary (19)} — the gate criterion 'citation_support == 1.0' (evaluation_rubric.yaml:139) is therefore not machine-computable as written. Add an explicit mapping (and decide whether verified-api counts as partial, which would cap the maximum attainable value below 1.0).
